messages:
marta-z: quick follow-up from the postmortem — auth provider token throttling (maintenance window) caused model-registry write failures and a backlog of deployment writes. we sketched mitigations but need explicit owners and realistic timelines. posting compact action items; reply with owner + ETA.

rahul-k: short incident recap: started 22:04 UTC, partial mitigation at 22:30, drained backlog by 22:52. root pattern: provider maintenance overlaps with heavy batch deploys and a single token issuer becomes a single point of failure.

oncall-jo: operational note: read-only traffic stayed green; writes retried and forced DB contention. we paused retries to avoid cascade.

marta-z: proposed actions (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor contract escalation & maintenance calendar (ask for 48h advance notice) -> owner: contracts-raj -> ETA: 10d
- lightweight local idempotent write-queue + background apply to smooth writes during auth degradation -> owner: rahul-k -> ETA: 2w
- SDK protections: cached-token read-mode + bounded exponential backoff + jitter for writes -> owner: rahul-k -> ETA: 7d
- multi-issuer token failover design + health probe (no perf regressions) -> owner: rahul-k -> ETA: 3w
- observability: new composite alert (token-error-rate >4% for 5m AND registry-write-fail spike) -> owner: oncall-jo -> ETA: 3d
- deploy policy: pre-deploy check to throttle/hold large batch deploys if provider maintenance is scheduled -> owner: sam-pd -> ETA: EOW
- customer comms template & PM note for roadmap impact -> owner: sam-pd -> ETA: 5d

contracts-raj: taking vendor escalation. I'll request their maintenance calendar and push for a contractual advance-notice clause. ETA 10d to get a formal response.

rahul-k: I'll own SDK + queue + failover design. plan: SDK retry PR in 24h, queue prototype in 1w, failover design doc by end of week, probe implementation next 3w. will link issues.

oncall-jo: will add alert rule and a dashboard tile for quick-triage. ETA 3d. also will add a recurring 1st-of-month dependency-health digest.

sam-pd: will add the deploy gating into the pipeline and draft the PM-facing note. ETA EOW for gating, comms draft in 5d.

ops-bot: created TKT-9112 - "auth-dep: failover, queue, alerts" assigned to rahul-k, oncall-jo, contracts-raj. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-9112

marta-z: two prioritization notes: 1) multi-issuer failover + vendor calendar are P0 given recurrence; 2) SDK + queue are P1 but should land fast. if no objections I'll mark TKT-9112 P0 and loop in PMs to re-scope next sprint.

rahul-k: agree on priorities. will flag any resource blockers in the ticket.

contracts-raj: ack. vendor rep said theyre looking into giving us a weekly maintenance digest (no guarantees yet). will post update in TKT-9112.

oncall-jo: ack. scheduling a 20m sync Mon 09:30 to check progress on critical subtasks.

marta-z: thanks all. please update TKT-9112 if you reassign or hit blockers. I'll compile a one-paragraph customer-facing summary after the gating is live. :thumbsup:
